<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/run/{id}/heartbeat"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Executor protocol. Reports that the executor of the run's campaign run is alive; any run of the tree may be named. A running campaign run whose executor sends no heartbeat for 5 minutes is failed. The answer says whether a cancel was requested, so the executor can stop and finish the run as `CANCELLED`. Not rate limited.
